summary: First full run for Multi-City AOL Phase 1. Unit tests: 27/27 pass. New integration suite test_citysites_api.py: 27/27 pass (host->city resolution incl. case, :443, trailing dot, X-Forwarded-Host priority; unknown host 404 + WARNING + cityId=unknown log; cityId=ottawa log; /healthz any host; ?lang=fr 303 + cookie -> bonjour; /api/site; 401 without token / 403 for member on /api/admin/* and /api/users; config edit applies right away, duplicate host and bad timezone give 422, new city localhost:5699 resolves, PNG logo upload shows on / and /api/logo/<id> returns image/png, bad file type gives 400, Reset to file; text override hi/revert; role promote/demote, only-admin demote 409, bad role 403, unknown user 404). UI (Playwright, sign-in tickets): home EN/FR, SPA header EN/FR on /sign-in, Clerk form renders, member dashboard 'Coming up' with no admin menu, refresh keeps session, member /admin/logs shows admin-not-allowed; admin menu, access logs table + city/host/unknown filters + paging (Page 1 of 4 -> 2 of 4); texts hi -> 'hi ottawa' -> empty -> 'hello'; users promote/demote, demoting the only admin shows 'Keep at least one admin' toast and the select stays admin; site config edit Mississauga (curl showed 'hello test_missi ui'), site-config-error for a duplicate host and for a bad timezone, added city testui/localhost:5699 resolved, logo upload preview and curl showed /api/logo/<id>; clicked 'Reset to file' at the end (source = configuration file, Mississauga back, 5699 -> 404, hello text restored). Mobile 390px layout checked. One backend bug found: a malformed defaultBehavior returns 500.

minor.issue: If defaultBehavior is not an object (e.g. "defaultBehavior": "x"), it returns 500 Internal Server Error (AttributeError in site_config._check_behavior: behavior.get). It should return 422 with a validation message. The same crash would stop startup with a traceback instead of a ConfigError.

The unit tests use TestClient against the real app/DB, so they write access_logs rows into the real Mongo database (ip='testclient', hosts unknown.example/nowhere.example). That pollutes the admin access logs. Point the tests at a separate DB or mock record_visit.
The in-memory _logo_cache has no size limit (minor memory growth).

integration_issues.issue: React.StrictMode runs the track effect twice in dev, so every SPA page view is saved twice in access_logs (e.g. /admin/logs and /sign-in show 2 rows with the same second). Production builds are not affected, but preview logs are doubled. Guard it with a ref or de-dupe it.
/ always shows 'Sign up / Log in', even for a signed-in user (the SPA pages show 'My dashboard' + avatar). This may be fine for Phase 1, but it is inconsistent.

issues: The admin nav and the logs table scroll sideways and the Host column is cut off. It works, but a stacked/card layout would read better on mobile.

action_items: site_config._check_behavior: check isinstance(behavior, dict) and add a ConfigError message instead of crashing (500)
Keep the unit tests from writing to the real access_logs collection
Optional: de-dupe the /api/track call under StrictMode; optionally show the signed-in state on the server-rendered home
critical_code_review_comments: site_config.py _check_behavior: raw.get('defaultBehavior') or {} followed by behavior.get crashes for non-dict values (500)
roles.set_role: the 'keep at least one admin' check (count then update) is not atomic; two admins demoting each other at the same time could leave zero admins

SiteConfig.jsx upload uses the draft cityId; if an admin renames a saved city's ID without saving, the upload returns 404 'Unknown city'. Uploading also saves the server config while unsaved draft edits stay only in the browser (expected but could confuse)
clerk_auth._client_ip trusts X-Forwarded-For unconditionally (only used for the Clerk proxy, so low risk)
